mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_record r WHERE r.license_plate = #{licensePlate} AND r.status = 'PARKING'

SELECT s.id AS id, a.id AS area_id, a.area_code AS area_code, s.space_code AS space_code FROM parking_space s JOIN parking_area a ON a.id = s.area_id WHERE a.parking_lot_id = #{lotId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.status = 'FREE' ORDER BY a.area_code, s.space_code, s.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_space SET status = 'OCCUPIED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{spaceId} AND status = 'FREE'
mapper.select: SELECT v.id FROM vehicle v WHERE v.license_plate = #{licensePlate} AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO parking_record (record_no, parking_lot_id, vehicle_id, license_plate, parking_space_id, fee_rule_id, entry_admin_id, entry_time, status) VALUES (#{recordNo}, #{parkingLotId}, #{vehicleId}, #{licensePlate}, #{parkingSpaceId}, #{feeRuleId}, #{entryAdminId}, #{entryTime}, 'PARKING')
ON CONFLICT (record_no) DO NOTHING
